parsed.text: A shopper is obliged to take the available entrance cart before proceeding with the shopping trip.
Items may only be picked up while the shopper is pushing or holding a cart.
The shopper is prohibited from carrying loose goods by hand rather than transporting them in the cart.
Before leaving the store, the shopper is obliged to park the cart in the return bay at cell (0,1).
Whenever the shopper reaches the return bay while still pushing the cart, they are obliged to put the cart down there.
If a cart is put down anywhere other than the return bay, the shopper is obliged to pick it back up before leaving.
The shopper is prohibited from exiting the supermarket while still pushing or holding a cart.
Carts are prohibited in the eastern checkout and exit side of the store, so the shopper must leave the cart before entering that region.
